selection: Sort eligible points by (exact original private-target removal loss, point label), select the first three. All other points form the retained core; unchanged16-point rows are included in the multiset.
fingerprint_encoding: SHA256 of compact JSON of the sorted list of all301 sorted retained cores, including fixed rows; multiplicities preserved.
scope: Equal core multisets imply the same unrestricted16-point completion domains under this exact core-selection rule. No options, kernel columns or optimizer were run, and no covering bound follows.
